Turkey Detains 26 in Crackdown on LGBTQ+ and HIV Support Groups

Turkish authorities have detained 26 individuals in a crackdown targeting LGBTQ+ and HIV support groups. The operation involved blocking online accounts and was described by authorities as a measure against 'obscenity.' The detentions occurred as these groups were reportedly attempting to organize events. The exact nature of the support provided by the targeted groups was not detailed in the coverage.
